resultText:
The specification for the rooms paging bug is written and ready for `/speckit-plan`; no code was changed and nothing was committed.

- **Feature directory**: `specs/003-fix-rooms-pagination` (recorded in `.specify/feature.json`)
- **Spec file**: `specs/003-fix-rooms-pagination/spec.md`
- **Checklist**: `specs/003-fix-rooms-pagination/checklists/requirements.md` — all 16 items pass on the first iteration, with no `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers.
- **Hooks**: there is no `.specify/extensions.yml`, so no hooks ran and no branch was created; the work stays on `main`.

The spec has three stories: correct paging at every allowed page size (P1), the written root-cause analysis before any code change (P2), and a regression test that fails without the fix (P3).

Assumptions I made, all listed in the spec:
- **Allowed page size** means what the system already accepts: 1 to 100, default 10, pages starting at 1.
- **A page past the last one** keeps returning an empty list with the correct total, as today.
- **Bookings are out of scope**; if the analysis finds the same defect there, it is recorded but not fixed in this change.
- **The root-cause write-up** goes in `research.md` during the planning step, so the spec itself does not state the cause.

While checking the allowed page sizes I saw the likely cause, which the plan step should confirm: `apps/room/src/room/room.repository.ts:19` computes the number of rooms to skip from the default page size (10) instead of the requested one. The repository test only checks page 2 at 10 per page, where the two values coincide.
